pairs.statement: UN mission, Toronto Star, Hindu and IHRF reports specifically attribute the strikes to Pakistan and confirm 13 civilian deaths, undercutting the 'competing claims' framing.
pairs.why: Multiple sourced reports name Pakistan as the strike origin with a specific death toll, structurally bypassing the symmetry of 'trading claims'.
